Initial release of "Islamic TikTok Stories" skill — an end-to-end, multi-agent pipeline for creating faceless Islamic story videos for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.

- Orchestrates five specialist agents: Story, Script, Visual, Voice, and Assembly for fully-automated video creation.
- Enforces strict brand identity using a faceless narrator in all videos.
- Guarantees compliance with Islamic sensitivities (no faces for Prophets, Sahaba, Angels).
- Story scenes are generated in a consistent painterly art style with on-brand visuals.
- Ready for batch production of educational, faceless Islamic short-form content.
